infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SOMA uses your microphone so you can talk to Soma instead of typing. Audio is sent for transcription and is not stored.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SOMA turns what you say into text so Soma can understand and reply to you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SOMA lets you choose a photo for your profile so the people you connect with can see you.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SOMA uses the camera so you can take a profile photo and scan another person's Synergy code.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SOMA uses your approximate location to suggest people near enough to actually meet. Your exact position is never shown to anyone.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: SOMA does not track you across other apps or websites.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SOMA uses your approximate location to show real people nearby. Your exact position is never shared.

plugins.photosPermission: SOMA uses your photos so you can set a profile picture. Nothing is uploaded until you choose one.

plugins.microphonePermission: SOMA uses your microphone so you can talk to Soma instead of typing.
